meta.name: Hello Bachhon
meta.description: A physics teacher sets out to make quality education accessible to all students through online learning.

videos.title: Deewar
videos.overview: Physics teacher Alakh Pandey inspires scores of students — but funding issues threaten his work. Hariya, an impoverished boy, dreams of a medical career.

videos.title: Solution
videos.overview: As Alakh grapples with teacher resignations, Aditya, a down-on-his-luck teen, looks for a way to turn his rebellious life around.

videos.title: Zimmedari
videos.overview: While reflecting on his past, Alakh and the team receive a major offer. Juggling sports and school, aspiring cricketer Rishabh faces a reality check.

videos.title: Rakhi
videos.overview: Alakh seeks a way forward as doubt swirls. Tripti works hard to succeed in school amid family strife. But help soon comes from an unlikely source.

videos.title: Cut-Off
videos.overview: With new funding, Alakh takes his dream offline. Enduring immense pressure to excel in class, Lakshya's life takes a dark turn when his scores slip.
